description: Use this when you need the title/abstract screening decisions: per record the decision, whether a human or the AI made it, and per criterion the verdict and the reason quoting the abstract, with a flag saying whether the quote was found verbatim. action results (filter by decision; 10 per page with limit and cursor; detail concise shows the key criterion with a short quote, detail full every criterion) or action conflicts (records left in 'review' or in disagreement). Those, and records hit by a criteria change, are decided by the researcher in revisia: give them human_review's link and message. Never judge or decide them yourself, nor offer to. Read-only; respects blind dual screening.

detail.description: concise: decision + key criterion, quote cut; full: every criterion with its quote.

name: revisia_screening
title: Screening results
